title: How do machines learn? Evaluating the Alcon2abs method
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion as it does not study any aspect of religion or faith. The study evaluates a pedagogical method for teaching machine learning to the general public and finds it to be effective for a diverse audience, including children, adolescents, and adults.
